scope: Focused IndexedDB native bindings and eight original imported WPT pages in directly instantiated native Page processes
changes: Convert IndexedDB keys directly from engine values instead of using structured clone; preserve exact getter exceptions, own array indices, shared array children, cycles, internal Date slots and binary view slices.

Expose ordered IDBObjectStore.getKey() and IDBIndex.count() requests, including explicit commit, deleted-source validation, request owner identity and worker task dispatch.
